title: Settling a Certificate of Deposit Penalty to the Whole Cent
content:
The cent at which the figure charged on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line comes to rest is graded by the owner's checking balance and by whether the certificate has been renewed before.

## 1. The grades

The rounding of the figure charged is graded: where the owner's active checking balance is at least the smallest partial withdrawal the tier accepts and the certificate has run through at least one earlier term, the figure is rounded up to the whole cent; where the owner holds an active checking account whose balance is below the smallest partial withdrawal the tier accepts, the figure is rounded down to the whole cent; otherwise the figure is rounded to the nearest cent with a half rounded up.

## 2. The figure the grades turn on

The smallest partial withdrawal is 500.00 USD on each of the four tiers of the Certificates of Deposit line that accept one, those tiers being the 12-Month, 18-Month Bump-Up, 36-Month and 60-Month Certificates. The balance set against it is that of the owner's active account on the bank's Personal Checking line.

## 3. Condition and result

| Owner's active checking balance | Earlier terms run through | The figure charged settles |
|---|---|---|
| 500.00 USD or more | 1 or more | rounded up to the whole cent |
| 500.00 USD or more | none | rounded to the nearest cent, a half rounded up |
| below 500.00 USD, an active checking account being held | any | rounded down to the whole cent |
| no active checking account held | any | rounded to the nearest cent, a half rounded up |

The second row is worth marking: a substantial checking balance alone does not reach the first grade, which asks for an earlier term as well.

## 4. What the three grades do to one figure

| Figure worked out | Rounded up to the cent | Rounded down to the cent | Nearest cent, a half rounded up |
|---|---|---|---|
| 214.6301 | 214.64 | 214.63 | 214.63 |
| 214.6350 | 214.64 | 214.63 | 214.64 |
| 214.6899 | 214.69 | 214.68 | 214.69 |
| 214.6000 | 214.60 | 214.60 | 214.60 |

A figure already exact to the cent settles at itself under all three grades; nothing is lifted a further cent.
